lines.beaver_en: Has your view of life changed lately?
lines.en: Yes, I narrowly escaped death last year.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, that must have been really hard.
lines.en: Between life and death, I felt providence.

lines.beaver_en: So it became a blessing in disguise.
lines.en: Yes, far from resenting it, I became grateful.

lines.beaver: 가치관이나 삶의 의미에 대해 더 말해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about your values or life's meaning?
lines.beaver_roman: Gachigwanina salmui uimie daehae deo malhae jullaeyo?
lines.learner: 유서를 미리 써 보면서 삶을 돌아봤어요.
lines.en: Writing a will in advance, I looked back on my life.
lines.roman: Yuseoreul miri sseo bomyeonseo salmeul dorabwasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Even a will? What did you write?
lines.learner: 흥청망청 살며 팔자 탓만 했다고 썼어요.
lines.en: I wrote that I lived recklessly and just blamed fate.
lines.roman: Heungcheongmangcheong salmyeo palja tanman haetdago sseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: You've had many twists and turns. How about now?
lines.en: Even if I'm poor, I want to live morally.

lines.beaver_en: Then what do you think about success?
lines.en: I believe great talents mature late. Late is okay.

lines.beaver_en: Young people these days rush to succeed, you know.
lines.en: If you deceive others in the name of success, you'll be ruined.

lines.beaver: 안락사 같은 윤리 문제는 어떻게 생각해요?
lines.beaver_en: What do you think about ethical issues like euthanasia?
lines.beaver_roman: Allaksa gateun yulli munjeneun eotteoke saenggakaeyo?
lines.en: Life is noble, but autonomous choice matters too.

lines.beaver: 파란만장한 일을 겪어서 그런지 생각이 깊네요.
lines.beaver_en: Maybe because of all your ups and downs, you think deeply.
lines.beaver_roman: Paranmanjanghan ireul gyeokkeoseo geureonji saenggagi gimneyo.
lines.en: I plan to keep living believing right always prevails.
